policy_floor: accepted ADR-0016 normative requirement (data-classification paragraph: re-open section 8 before a hashed or synced blob carries install_location)
trigger: an agent sends a non-empty install_location in the synced blob
classification_rationale: ADR-0016 lines 424-436 require re-opening section 8 before a hashed or synced blob carries install_location; the server accepted, hashed and stored it
summary: Review 5393771363 (re-stated in 5394641495): the server accepts, hashes and persists install_location before section 8 is re-opened. The owner ruled out amending the ADR, so the reviewer's other route was taken: wire slots 13-14 (install_location, uninstall_string) are reserved. Parsed and discarded, never stored or hashed, SoftwareEntry loses both members, v7 adds only package_id and source. Fixed in 487a44979; verified by a new test (no such columns, no stored text, hash is the reserved-empty form, a claim including the values gets need_full) and four mutation runs. Found by Kimi K3 and Codex Sol via the reviewer.

classification_rationale: the test named a newer agent but supplied the 16-field hash, so it did not model a real 17-field agent
summary: The 17-field case now claims the hash a newer agent computes over all 17 fields (kSeventeenFieldHash) and asserts the hash-only follow-up is need_full, worded as bounded mixed-version degradation (487a44979).

trigger: an auditor reads the ladder and ledger without GitHub access
classification_rationale: the ladder said 'that is the ADR-0008 exception for v7', author-written in the same PR with no approver named, while no exception document exists
summary: The record now names its source (review 5394641495 by FortitudeEtc relaying the maintainer's decision), says no separate ADR-0008 exception document exists, and states the staged-start rule below 2M rows (915c3b965).

trigger: a later agent build fills slots 13-14
classification_rationale: the manual said 'reserved: server ignores them' without the consequence of an agent filling them; ruled below the six REQUIRED categories (an operator-visible behaviour only a future agent triggers)
summary: Found by enterprise-readiness and (as the bounded need_full cost) by security-guardian, unhappy-path and sre. The manual and changelog now say a build that fills the slots gets a full-resend request every cycle until the server accepts them (915c3b965). Measured by unhappy-path: about +0.86 full reports per day per affected agent, visible in yuzu_inventory_ingest_total{outcome=need_full} and the high-need_full alert; no shipped agent triggers it.

classification_rationale: the 'rolling upgrade not supported' decision appeared only in the maintainers' ladder
summary: Found by enterprise-readiness and consistency-auditor (CA-1: the ladder said rolling is unsupported while the manual allows a staged start below 2M rows). upgrading.md gains a short operator note, and the ladder states the staged-start rule (915c3b965).

trigger: a reader skims the changed prose
classification_rationale: five wording items: an orphaned 'The risk is accepted only while' sentence, the SoftwareEntry member-order note, chained parentheticals and an unwrapped line in the manual, ragged comment wraps, and a dense routed-row clause
summary: All five reworded (915c3b965). No truth contradictions were found; every REQUIRED doc is present (changelog fragment, manual, routed row, test-coverage, ladder).

trigger: clang-format check or a reader of the comment
classification_rationale: two added comment lines exceeded the 100-column limit and tests/meson.build still said SoftwareEntry has 16 members
summary: Reflowed and recounted (14 stored members, 16 wire slots) in 915c3b965.

trigger: someone relies on the comment when changing either sort key
classification_rationale: entry_less/entry_equal carried 'MUST mirror the agent's', but the agent never keyed on the tail fields
summary: Comment now states the real relationship (agent keys 12 fields, the server adds package_id and source which no shipped agent fills, so they agree today; #5186 must extend the agent key) and that records differing only in the reserved slots collapse to one row (915c3b965).

trigger: whoever implements #5186 follows the issue text
classification_rationale: issue #5186 still describes the 'any of the four non-empty' tail rule and has no step for the server to un-reserve slots 13-14
summary: Raised by architect, consistency-auditor and unhappy-path (which also noted that the 3 MiB blob cap counts bytes the server discards, to check in the agent change). Handled by a comment on the existing open issue #5186 stating the reserved slots, the current tail rule, the v8 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS need and the cap interplay, instead of a new issue.

classification_rationale: the discard of slots 13-14 is silent: no log line names it when an agent's hash keeps missing
summary: Not adding one: yuzu_inventory_ingest_total{outcome=need_full}, the phase=full duration histogram and the YuzuInventoryHighNeedFullRatio alert already surface the loop, and the loop cannot occur with a shipped agent. Per-agent attribution is a general inventory gap, not this change's.

trigger: operator runs the earlier unreleased head on a migrated database
classification_rationale: rolling back to the earlier PR head against a database this build migrated fails the projection guard and refuses to start (fail-closed)
summary: Applies only to an unreleased PR head: origin/dev has no v7. It fails closed with the missing column named; rolling forward fixes it. Same conclusion from sre.

trigger: a developer database that ran the earlier v7
classification_rationale: databases that ran the earlier v7 keep two unused empty-default columns; nothing purges them and a later ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS with a different type would be skipped
summary: The earlier v7 was never released and no agent can fill the columns, so a purge is not warranted; reported independently by security-guardian, architect and unhappy-path. The v8 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS point goes into the #5186 comment.

trigger: a regression stores the value in a new table or column
classification_rationale: the 'no such columns' check had no positive control, and no test filled slots 13-14 with an empty tail
summary: Both added (915c3b965): a positive control on package_id/source columns, and a record with only slots 13-14 filled that leaves the tail unopened (12-field hash form). QE's speculative note that a value could hide in a differently named column has no code path (no member, parser discards) and is not pursued.

trigger: a fleet of future agents fills the slots
classification_rationale: suggested an extra sentence in the YuzuInventoryHighNeedFullRatio alert description about reserved-slot agents
summary: Covered by the manual sentence added in 915c3b965; the alert file is a separate gate with its own tests and is not touched for a case no shipped agent triggers.

classification_rationale: two optional shrinks (one hex literal, one shared throwaway string)
summary: Rejected with evidence in ponytail-review.5172.blocker2.md: the split keeps the reserved slots visible at the hash-contract site and a shared sink for two slots is a trap if the walk stops assigning.
